name: Green Flames
descriptionTemplate: Deal [Damage:Arg1] {Pierce DMG}, inflict [Arg2]% of DMG as {Poison}. At turn end, if in hand or in {Ultra Space}, upgrade to {Corrupted Flames}. Can be played with insufficient Arithmetica, changing its effect to Gain [Energy:Arg3] Aliemus and {Exhaust}.
lore:
Liz still remembers the day she obtained the Green Flames.
The cyan spark danced in her palm, urging her to fulfill her long-suppressed wish.
